Access to a vendor-managed service's administrative console (such as a payment processor) is treated the same as production database access for approval purposes, requiring approval from the data owner for that integration and one engineering manager [54b5200c0f4ab243c0eb22bd471d9068]. Administrative-tier vendor access additionally requires sign-off from a director-level approver [54b5200c0f4ab243c0eb22bd471d9068]. In comparison, standard internal production database access for engineers requires sign-off from both the data owner and two engineering managers (one from a different team) and lasts for a shorter duration of three days [da1cdb5e0e87ad69728e9d2781239d13].
